story: Meet the Whiteheads Broadbill (Calyptomena whiteheadi), a distinctive bird from the Calyptomenidae family. With an IUCN status of Least Concern (LC), its population trends are closely watched by scientists and enthusiasts. The Whiteheads Broadbill serves as an indicator species for the health of its environment.
